{{Quote|I hurt my neck last time I did this. Let's try to avoid collisions.|Wad'e Tay'haai|<ref name="order66" />}}
'''Wad'e Tay'haai''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was one of seventy-five [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors that were comprised in the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'', a group of training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] hired by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to train the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] they created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Try Wad’e Tay’haai or Mij Gilamar, then. They’d be a bit more tolerant of the osik from the top. Not much, but at least Zey won’t get a vibroblade in a sensitive spot if he uses the wrong fork at dinner.|Kal Skirata on Wad'e Tay'haai|<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
Wad'e Tay'haai was a member of the group who were a cadre of battle-hardened training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] hand-picked by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to train elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Although most of the ''Cuy'val Dar'' disappeared after completing the terms of their contract following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arligan Zey]] later requested that several return to instruct [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] selected for commando cross-training such as the [[Covert Ops clone trooper|covert ops clone troopers]]. A reluctant Tay'haai eventually joined [[Mij Gilamar]] in accepting the offer, but they did so with ulterior motives, agreeing to assist [[Kal Skirata]] in his efforts to investigate the Republic's shifting strategies in the waning days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Near the end of the Clone Wars, mere days after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Tay'haai left the GAR with liberated clones, a party led by [[Kal Skirata]].

==Equipment==
Wearing purple [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], Tay'haai wielded a traditional Mandalorian hunting spear known as a ''[[bevii'ragir]]'' and a ''[[bes'bev]]'' [[Flute/Legends|flute]] weapon.
